findings.problem: Editor merged comment and SQL into one line; grader marked a correct query as wrong due to the inline comment swallowing the SQL.
findings.evidence: With text “-- Keep customer rows… SELECT full_name, status FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL;” Check returned Attempts: 1✕ Not correct and showed a SQL error. Removing the comment and submitting “SELECT full_name, status FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL;” passed and advanced.
findings.learnerImpact: Valid SQL with a comment can fail grading, causing unnecessary retries and confusion.
findings.attemptedAction: Removed the comment and resubmitted; passed.
